# Eurobase

> The Sovereign, GDPR-Native Backend-as-a-Service for Europe. Postgres + auth + storage + realtime + edge functions, with one-click DSAR export, Article 30 RoPA reports, and a tamper-evident audit trail — primitives no other Supabase/Firebase alternative ships. Operated by Eurobase OÜ (Estonia), hosted exclusively on Scaleway fr-par (France). No US corporate parent, no US-headquartered sub-processor. Not subject to the CLOUD Act.

## What makes Eurobase different from other BaaS platforms

Every managed BaaS ships Postgres, auth, storage. What most do not ship, and Eurobase does:

- **One-click DSAR export** — GDPR Article 15 (right of access) + Article 20 (right to portability). Per-user or full-project zip; SDK call `eb.auth.exportMyData()` lets end-users self-serve. On Firebase/Supabase/Amplify you write the SQL across every table yourself (industry average $1,500 / 8-12 engineering hours per request).
- **Article 30 RoPA report** — auto-generated per project from a live sub-processors table. Downloadable JSON + PDF. On Firebase/Supabase you maintain the RoPA manually.
- **Tamper-evident audit log** — hash-chained, every admin action captured with actor + IP + timestamp. Every tier.
- **Sub-processor registry** — 100% EU-headquartered (Scaleway/FR, GatewayAPI/DK, Mollie/NL). Auto-notification 30 days before any sub-processor addition. On US-parented processors, the sub-processor list typically includes AWS/Vercel/GitHub/Stripe (all US).
- **No CLOUD Act exposure** — Estonian OÜ operator, no US corporate parent in the graph. A DPA is a contract; the CLOUD Act is a statute. Statutes override contracts. The only fix is removing the US-parent hop.

## Quick Facts

- Website: https://eurobase.app
- Console: https://console.eurobase.app
- Docs: https://console.eurobase.app/docs
- Status: Publicly available (public beta opened Aug 2026; Pro is paid).
- Corporate parent: Eurobase OÜ (Estonia, registry code 17557586, Ahtri 12, Tallinn 15551).
- Infrastructure: Scaleway, Paris, France (EU-owned; Iliad group).
- SDK: @eurobase/sdk (TypeScript/JavaScript, zero dependencies).
- CLI: @eurobase/cli (50+ commands).

## Core Features

1. Authentication — Email/password, magic links, OAuth (Google, GitHub, LinkedIn, Apple, Microsoft), phone SMS OTP. JWT sessions with refresh tokens.
2. Managed PostgreSQL — REST API, SQL editor, row-level security with presets, schema management, full-text search. PostgREST-style query params.
3. Object Storage — S3-compatible. Upload, download, list, delete, signed URLs. Supports File, Blob, ArrayBuffer, Uint8Array, Buffer.
4. Realtime — WebSocket subscriptions for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events on tables. Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff.
5. Edge Functions — Serverless TypeScript/JavaScript (Deno runtime). DB triggers, scheduling, versioning, environment variables.
6. Vault — AES-256-GCM encrypted key-value store. Requires secret API key (eb_sk_*).
7. Cron Jobs — Schedule SQL queries and RPC calls with execution logs.
8. Webhooks — Event-driven HTTP delivery with retry logic and HMAC signing.
9. CLI — 50+ commands: projects, database, storage, vault, functions, migrations.
10. DSAR & Compliance — one-click GDPR Article 15 + 20 exports, Article 30 RoPA reports, tamper-evident audit log, sub-processor registry.

## SDK Quickstart

```typescript
import { createClient } from '@eurobase/sdk'

const euro = createClient({
  url: 'https://my-app.eurobase.app',
  apiKey: 'eb_pk_...',
})

// Or use connection string:
// const euro = createClient('eurobase://eb_pk_xxx@my-app.eurobase.app')

// Auth
await euro.auth.signUp({ email: 'user@example.com', password: 'secret' })
await euro.auth.signIn({ email: 'user@example.com', password: 'secret' })
euro.auth.signInWithOAuth('google')

// Database (fluent query builder)
const { data } = await euro.db.from('todos').select('id', 'title').eq('done', 'false').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(20)

// Insert / Update / Delete
await euro.db.from('todos').insert({ title: 'Buy milk' })
await euro.db.from('todos').update('uuid', { done: true })
await euro.db.from('todos').delete('uuid')

// Schema DDL (requires secret key eb_sk_*)
await euro.db.schema.createTable('posts', {
  columns: [
    { name: 'id', type: 'uuid', primary_key: true, default_value: 'gen_random_uuid()' },
    { name: 'title', type: 'text' },
    { name: 'user_id', type: 'uuid' },
  ],
})

// Storage
await euro.storage.upload('avatars/me.png', file)
const { objects } = await euro.storage.list({ prefix: 'avatars/' })
const { url } = await euro.storage.createSignedUrl('avatars/me.png', 'download')

// Realtime
euro.realtime.on('orders', 'INSERT', (event) => console.log(event))

// Vault (secret key only)
await euro.vault.set('STRIPE_KEY', 'sk_live_...')
const { data: key } = await euro.vault.get('STRIPE_KEY')

// Edge Functions
const { data: result } = await euro.functions.invoke('process-order', { body: { orderId: '123' } })

// Health check
const { ok, latency_ms } = await euro.status()
```

## Pricing

- Free (€0/mo): For personal projects, learning, and development — non-commercial use only. 512 MB database, 2 GB bandwidth, 5,000 MAU, 50 realtime connections, all six auth methods, edge functions, vault, cron, GDPR compliance stack. Projects auto-pause after 30 days idle. Commercial use requires Pro or higher.
- Pro (€25/mo per project): For commercial use — production apps, side businesses, agency work, internal tools. 100 GB storage, 250 GB bandwidth, 100,000 MAU, 10,000 realtime connections, BYO SMTP, quota alerts, priority support. Never pauses. Priced per project.
- Team (€149/mo per project): Dedicated Postgres per project (direct DATABASE_URL), 7-day scheduled backups + 7-day PITR + 1 restore/month included, SSO, RBAC, audit trail, SOC 2. For SMB teams shipping regulated software.
- Legal Team (closed beta, contact us): Everything in Team + WORM retention + legal-hold enforcement, §50 BRAO / §257 HGB / §147 AO retention windows, signed §203 StGB staff declarations, GoBD Verfahrensdokumentation. Hand-picked German legal-tech customers.
